title: Mission Give Laredo Holds 21st Annual Donation Drive for Bethany House
excerpt: The 21st annual Mission Give Laredo Donation Drive collected food, hygiene items and new clothing Saturday at Sames Kia of Laredo to benefit Bethany House of Laredo and the unsheltered people it serves.
content:
Laredoans turned out Saturday for a holiday tradition of giving. The 21st annual Mission Give Laredo Donation Drive ran from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. on Nov. 21, collecting donations for Bethany House of Laredo.

Donors dropped off non-perishable foods, personal hygiene items, new clothing and more at Sames Kia of Laredo.

Bethany House of Laredo is a nonprofit that assists unsheltered people in Laredo, and the donations help run and support the organization as it helps those in need.

The drive has run for 21 years, making it one of the community's longest-running holiday donation efforts.

Source: Mission Give Laredo, Nov. 21, 2026.
